sizing: Highest shared admissible class per pair; individual class if none shared. Priorities descend whole classes until source-feasible; all conflicting grown priorities descend together until round-round clearance holds. KEEP exact source if no growth class. Apply A-square/B-envelope bound by descending whole classes. Frozen before construction.
